name: Lexicon-based Sentiment Analysis (AFINN/Bing/NRC dictionaries)
when_to_use: Polarity/emotion of text via a join with a ready-made lexicon, with no labeled/training data needed; English corpus in the material (e.g., Jane Austen novels).

expected_input.question: What is the polarity/emotion of a text?

plain_explanation.purpose: Measures whether a text is positive or negative by summing scores of words from a dictionary.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you want an opinion thermometer without labeling anything.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A text column and a dictionary of words with scores.
plain_explanation.example: Measure the tone of customer reviews.
